component.name: Snapcord
component.summary: Cliente leve de Discord focado em voz

description.p: Snapcord is a native Discord client built with C++ and Qt, without an embedded browser, so it uses little memory and almost no CPU while idle. It focuses on voice calls, with end-to-end encryption, noise suppression and echo cancellation, and also supports text chat and direct messages.
Snapcord is not affiliated with Discord. Using third-party clients goes against Discord's Terms of Service and may get your account suspended.
Moderation actions, a friends home, per-channel drafts, Discord videos inside the app, channel editing, server folders, sound effect styles, an About page and update notices.
Chat improvements: mentions, file uploads, an in-app image and video viewer, member list, profile cards and editing, Appearance themes, smooth animations and lighter background traffic.
First release: voice channels and calls, text chat, direct messages and notifications.
